description: 서울시설공단_도로관리처 소관 법정시설물 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울시설공단. 서울시설공단 도로관리처가 관리하는 서울시 자동차전용도로 내 법정 도로부속물(옹벽·비탈면) 현황입니다. 이 자료는 「시설물의 안전 및 유지관리에 관한 특별법(시설물안전법)」에 따라, 높이 5m 이상 구간의 총합이 100m 이상인 옹벽, 30m 이상 절토사면 중 수평 길이 100m 이상인 구간을 포함한 제1... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울시설공단. Its tags are 옹벽, 비탈면, 법정시설물, 도로안전, 시설물안전법. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
